description: Source code implementing a subscription vector data structure for managing subscriptions, including functions for initialization, addition, removal, destruction, and dumping of subscription data.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a subscription vector structure by setting its vector pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a subscription to the subscription vector, reallocating memory as needed and copying the subscription data.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a subscription from the vector by marking it for deletion and performing garbage collection.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with the subscription vector and resets its state.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_DestroySubscriber
methods.description: Frees all dynamically allocated memory within a subscription structure.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_GetSubsByInstance
methods.description: Retrieves a subscription by its instance number.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_MarkSubscriptionForDeletion
methods.description: Marks a subscription as invalid and frees its associated memory.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_GarbageCollectSubscriptions
methods.description: Removes subscriptions marked for deletion from the vector, compacting the array.

methods.name: SUBS_VECTOR_Dump
methods.description: Logs the contents of the subscription vector for debugging purposes.
